1\. A retry can start two leads 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
start_lead() returns exit 1 when fire() times out or receives a response it cannot recognize,
even though the task may already have started a session. The handover instructions tell the lead to
retry immediately, while no lease or LEAD-STARTED marker necessarily exists to stop the second
fire.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A timed-out or unrecognized fire response can follow a successful server-side start. Returning a retryable failure can start a second lead before the first joins. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[3636-3651] - room.py[3768-3772] - LEAD.md[328-334] ## Recommended Fix Distinguish definitively rejected requests from requests with an unknown outcome. Do not instruct callers to fire again immediately after an unknown outcome; first reconcile whether a session started, or use an API-supported idempotency mechanism if available. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
